caption: A tray of ice cubes is taken from the freezer, and the cubes and tray frost over white.

sa.check: A tray of ice cubes is taken from a freezer.
A white frost forms on the tray and the cubes.
The frost appears first on the coldest surfaces.
The frost spreads as a haze.
The tray is taken out first and the frost follows.

pc.expect: The frost builds on the cold surfaces and any later change is toward wetness as the tray warms; it does not come and go.
pc.fail: The frost thickens, goes and thickens again; or the frost turns back to bare dry plastic and then frosts again; or wet drops turn back into dry white frost in the warm room; or the frost thins and thickens in turn.

pc.expect: The white appears on the tray and the cubes themselves and spreads across them, not on the warm counter around.
pc.fail: The frost appears on the counter while the tray stays bare; or the tray's plastic changes colour rather than frosting; or the frost appears on the wall behind; or the frost covers the whole scene.

pc.expect: Once the frost turns to drops they run downward on the tray's sides and gather below it.
pc.fail: A drop runs up the tray's side; or water gathers on the tray's top edge and stays as a dome; or a drop leaves the tray and rises; or a run travels sideways and stays level.

pc.expect: The frost is a fine white bloom on the surface that softens into beads as the tray warms, and the cubes stay hard solids in their wells.
pc.fail: The frost stands off as thick spikes of ice; or the frost peels away as a sheet; or the tray's plastic flexes as the frost grows; or a cube slumps while the frost is still growing.

pc.expect: One tray with its cubes; the cubes keep their number and stay in their wells.
pc.fail: A cube vanishes; or a new cube appears in an empty well; or a cube passes through the tray's floor; or the tray changes shape.

pc.expect: The tray's colour, the counter and the kitchen stay the same.
pc.fail: The tray changes colour; or the counter changes pattern; or items in the kitchen rearrange.
